name: Constantí (Spain)
description: Red field charged at the centre with a yellow laurel wreath in Roman style.
history: The official flag of Constantí is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, red, with a yellow laurel wreath of Roman style inscribed in an imaginary circle in the middle of the cloth, of diameter 5/9 of the height; published in the DOGC on 3 July 1995.

features.role: laurel wreath in Roman style at the centre
